services.desc: Students will learn the elements of organic improvisation. We will practice multiple types of edits between two and three person scenes, non-traditional group games, and finally create a form to showcase at the class graduation show. Our mission is to create an open, inclusive space that meets the needs of improvisers and improv teams. Subscribe to our newsletter for new course offerings, show announcements, and community
